audience: inventory and operations teams who run stock, sales and purchasing in Cin7 Core

useCases.title: Check stock levels by product and location
useCases.text: The AI reads on hand, allocated, available, on order and in transit stock per product, location, bin and batch. It can filter by SKU or location name.

useCases.title: Find open sales orders for a customer
useCases.text: The AI lists sales by order number or customer with their order, pick, pack, ship, invoice and payment statuses, and opens one sale for its lines.

useCases.title: Check purchase orders waiting to be received
useCases.text: The AI lists purchases with supplier, required-by date and receiving and payment statuses, and opens one for its lines and stock received.

useCases.title: Track stock transfers between locations
useCases.text: The AI lists transfers with from and to location, status and dates, and opens one for its lines, bins and batches.

useCases.title: Review stock adjustments
useCases.text: The AI lists stock adjustments with date, status and reference, and opens one for its lines with product, location, batch, quantity and unit cost.

useCases.title: Look up a product with its suppliers and prices
useCases.text: The AI finds a product by name or SKU and opens it with its bill of materials, suppliers, stock movements, reorder levels and customer-specific prices.
